pages.text: Workhand Shovels upgrade the standard shovel with area digging capabilities. Each material tier (Stone, Iron, Diamond) offers 4 grades of tools with increasing digging areas.

pages.title: Grade Progression
pages.text:
$(bold)Grade 1$(): 3x3x1 area (single layer)
$(bold)Grade 2$(): 3x3x3 cubic OR 3x3x1 flat (right-click to toggle)
$(bold)Grade 3$(): 5x5x1 area (single layer)
$(bold)Grade 4$(): 5x5x5 cubic OR 5x5x1 flat (right-click to toggle)

pages.title: Controls
pages.text:
$(bold)Left-click$(): Area dig (when not sneaking)
$(bold)Shift + Left-click$(): Single block digging
$(bold)Right-click$(): Toggle between cubic and flat mode (Grades 2 & 4 only)

pages.title: Materials
pages.text:
All tools match the durability, mining speed, and enchantability of their vanilla counterparts:
Stone: 655 durability
Iron: 1250 durability
Diamond: 7805 durability
